item.title: Hakudaku Shimai ~Namaiki na Ano Ko no Kao ni Bukkakero!~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Nurejiru
  • 発売日: 2013-12-20
  • スコア: 6.08/10 (38 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 白濁姉妹 ～生意気なあの娘の顔にぶっかけろ！～
  • 英語名: Hakudaku Shimai Namaiki na Ano Ko no Kao ni Bukkakero!

あらすじ

Younger sister Aya and her older sister Mai are both in love with the boys next door, their childhood friends; older brother Yuuto and younger brother Haruto. However, coming home one day Aya is attacked and raped by strangers. Scared and uncertain she won’t go to the authorities for help. She can’t even bring herself to talk to her sister Mai or friends. To keep anyone from worrying she pretends everything is alright and tries to keep on smiling. Without facing consequences her attackers abuse her again and the number of rapists grow.

item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Nurejiru
  • 発売日: 2012-01-27
  • スコア: 7.040000000000001/10 (37 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 学園淫辱輪舞曲～純潔の乙女が淫らな牝へと堕ちるまで～
  • 英語名: Gakuen Injoku Rinbukyoku Junketsu no Otome ga Midara na Mesu e to Ochiru made

あらすじ

Protagonist Ariga Mio is a powerful girl with a well-developed sense for justice and a fighting spirit that doesn’t shy away from fights on school grounds.

Due to her misbehaviour, her parents who are concerned with their public image leave her no choice and force her to transfer to a school in the boonies that her younger brother attends. This is when she and her younger brother who had already been a wimp from very young age meet again.
